card.name: Dosing schedule and interval wording
card.fires_on: Words that start or name a dosing interval in recommended-dosage sections, such as Schedule in a heading, Q in Q2W, or every before a number of weeks or months.

modes.label: Schedule in headings
modes.description: The word Schedule or Schedules ending a heading like Recommended Dose and Schedule.
modes.example: 2.3 Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Recommended Dose and<< Schedule>> 28-day schedule The recommended dosage

modes.label: Q in Q2W/Q4W
modes.description: The Q of an abbreviated interval such as Q2W after every N weeks.
modes.example: .5 ): Recommended dosage for adult and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older is 300 mg given every 2 weeks (<<Q>>2W). Eosinophilic

modes.label: every before interval
modes.description: The word every after once, before a number of weeks or months.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dosage is 100 mg administered once<< every>> 6 months by subcutaneous injection

card.writes: It seems to prepare words about typical timing and durations, such as days or intervals.
card.plain: It fires where a label is about to state how often a drug is given.
